result.notes:
BUILD CHECK: I copied build.cjs and src/ to the scratchpad and ran node build.cjs there. All 16 built pages (landing-site/index.html and */index.html) are byte-identical to the committed built files, so the sources are exactly what is served. Working tree under landing-site/ is clean.

SERVING: In dev, scripts/landingSitePlugin.ts serves /, /about, /pricing, /research(/*), /security, /guides(/*), /how-it-works, /what-it-checks, plus /assets/* and /media/*, from landing-site/. In the prod build (closeBundle), it copies everything in landing-site/ except src, blender, notes, README.md, BEFORE-DEPLOY.md, build.cjs and serve.cjs into dist. That means the three dead old-hero files (media/hero.webm 7.8 MB, hero.mp4 7.0 MB, hero-white.mp4 7.1 MB, about 22 MB) currently ship to production even though nothing references them. blender/orig/media/*.mp4 (about 9.3 MB) is not deployed, only repo weight.

- / : record-stack hero (media/hero/m.mp4 at 767px and narrower, d.mp4 above, poster first.webp); MacBook walkthrough sequence; four exhibit tiles plus their summary-row icons (styles.css:640-643); green coin closer. No old imagery on /.

Nothing in landing-site/ uses AI 'scene' or atmosphere images. The old looks are the generated object renders: terrazzo, black clay, wood, puzzle pieces, pallets, striped 'dept' series, hex chain, hex prisms, coin column.

PROPOSED REPLACEMENT SET (exhibit style: one smooth untextured object, one saturated hue, a pastel tint of that hue, long soft shadow, plain off-white secondary):
(a) Four how-it-works step stills that replace the reels, in 1:1 slots: Connect = blue cards dropping into a white tray; Find = two lifted coral tiles in a white grid; Evidence = violet lens on a white record slab; Recover = green coin into a white dish.

(d) Delete media/hero.webm, hero.mp4, hero-white.mp4 and blender/orig/media/*.mp4. After (a), delete connect/find/build/recover .webm and .mp4. After (b) and (c), delete assets/cs-*.png and dept-*.png. Optional: the guides hexagon placeholder and the security icon panels, which are code-drawn and not generated imagery.

result.notes:
The audit was read-only. Nothing in the repo was edited, and no dev server was started. docs/mockups/ was ignored. Contact sheets and frames are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-AP-Leak-Finder/7a32b480-9194-5f00-baae-20a1ca3f0020/scratchpad/audit/archive/ (pp-atmos.png, pp-bg-scenes.png, pp-desktop.png, nr.png, docs-dr.png, landing-v2.png, orig-frames.png, ls-hero.png, frames/).

WHAT SHIPS
- vercel.json is {}, so Vercel runs `npm run build` and serves dist/.
- The Dockerfile runtime image copies only server/, src/ (with src/assets removed) and dist/. In production, server/index.ts serves dist/.
- dist/ is built from three sources:
  - the Vite build of the root index.html, plus public/;
  - tsc -b, which covers only src/, vite.config.ts and server/;
  - landingSitePlugin.closeBundle, which copies everything under landing-site/ except src, blender, notes, README.md, BEFORE-DEPLOY.md, build.cjs and serve.cjs.
- So none of the scope folders ship: .preview-pre-v2, night-report, docs, landing-v2, experiments, demo, plans, landing-site/blender/orig, landing-site/notes and scripts.
- demo/ builds only through vite.demo.config.ts and vite.onboarding-demo.config.ts, which output to demo-dist/ and demo-onboarding-dist/. Both are gitignored and dockerignored, and no npm script or deploy builds them.
- demo/ has no images of its own. It mounts the real AuditApp, so it shows whatever /audit shows, which is for the src/ and public/ audit.
- On the local Vite dev server, any project-root file can be fetched by path (for example /night-report/after/site-home.png). Nothing links to them, and this does not happen in production.

ACCIDENTAL SERVING (the main flag)
- landing-site/media/hero.webm, hero.mp4 and hero-white.mp4 (22 MB, the old hex-column hero) are copied into dist by the blanket landing-site copy. They are publicly reachable at /media/hero*, but nothing references them. Delete them.
- Structural risk: the same blanket copy ships every file left in landing-site/media/ and landing-site/assets/. Old renders keep shipping until they are deleted or excluded.
- The adjacent old imagery is still LIVE. This is for the landing-site auditor, and plan 002's D8 already names it:
  - landing-site/media/{connect,find,build,recover}.webm play on How It Works (how-it-works.html lines 48, 118, 186, 281).
  - Their .mp4 twins are served to Safari through the reels.js swap.
  - landing-site/assets/dept-*.png and cs-*.png are on About, Research and How It Works.

DUPLICATES IN THE LIVE TREE
- 109 of the 110 image files under .preview-pre-v2 are byte-identical to files still in src/assets/ or public/. The only exception is the old favicon.svg.
- Deleting .preview-pre-v2 therefore does not remove the old AI imagery from the repo. The same botanical, floral, geometric-world, warehouse, vellum, scenes, backgrounds and fresh-desktop files still sit in src/assets/landing/ and src/assets/app/. Whether anything reachable imports them is for the src/ auditor.
- scripts/prepare_landing_scene_plates.py, and its identical copy in .preview-pre-v2/scripts, crops those src/assets/landing/scenes plates. It is dead tooling and should be deleted with them.

WORKING-TREE ANOMALY (not caused by this audit)
- landing-site/blender/orig/media/find.mp4, hero.mp4 and recover.mp4 show as modified (git status ' M'). They were overwritten at 2026-10-19 22:59:54 UTC.
- All three are now the same 745,089-byte, 4 s clip of the orange/cyan wedge scene. HEAD has the real files (6.8 MB hero column, hex-tile find, disc-stack recover).
- This looks like collateral damage from a concurrent job; the mockup job was writing docs/mockups around the same time.
- It does not matter if orig/ is deleted as planned. Otherwise, `git checkout -- landing-site/blender/orig/media` restores them. This audit left them alone.

OTHER
- landing-site/notes, plans, experiments and scripts/qbo-sandbox contain no images (text or code only).
- landing-site/blender/orig/*.py (looklib terrazzo/oak/plywood materials, hero.py, solutions.py) generated the old block family. Delete them with orig/.
- plans/002 §2 D8 and §4 A4 already list the old 3D on sub pages and the onboarding black-clay cubes.

- src/workspace/WorkObject.tsx points at /media/stills/*.webp. That folder was deleted in 55b50c7, but WorkObject is not imported anywhere, so it is dead code, not a broken image.
- Hygiene, unrelated to imagery: .dockerignore does not list .preview-pre-v2, night-report, landing-v2 or experiments, so about 90 MB enters the Docker build context.
